name: A Small Favor
summary: A druid is asked to bring Twilight's Hammer magic to its source in the Twilight Shroud. Amberhall wants a cult thrall captured for questioning.

sections.title: A Druid's Favor
sections.body: Amberhall asks you for help in the Twilight Shroud. The reagents you gathered are attuned to Twilight's Hammer magic, and Amberhall says they can be used in a summoning ritual. To reach the source of that power, you are asked to use a conduit to call a cult thrall and capture it with Amberhall's Soulstone.

faq.q: What does Amberhall want me to do?
faq.answer: Amberhall asks you to summon a Twilight's Thrall from a conduit in the Twilight Shroud and capture it with Amberhall's Soulstone.
The reagents are attuned to Twilight's Hammer magic, making them suitable for a summoning ritual.

faq.q: Where do I use the conduit?
faq.answer: The conduit is within the Twilight Shroud.
Amberhall wants the Twilight's Thrall captured for questioning.

angles.text: As a druid, you are the one Amberhall calls a good little druid before asking for this favor.
